sources.text: and as the bride hung upon his arm he stumbled and fell dragging her down with him whereupon she beat him soundly and the neighbours said truly that things did not promise well for master peter's comfort
that the shadow went in through the half open balcony door of their opposite neighbor
and the strange servants who had been hired together with the house and knew nothing either about her
